summary: Regression + feature validation for the repeating phone-like ring alert in dashboard/Orders.jsx. Backend regression: 49 passed, 1 skipped (unchanged suites). Frontend: initial title correct and no badge on first load; alerts toggle flips 'Meldingen aanzetten' <-> 'Meldingen aan' with no console errors (AudioContext created on user gesture); creating order 1 via POST /api/public/restaurant/bistro-demo/orders is detected within 10s with tab title '(1) Bestellingen · Upxero Ordering' and 'Markeer als gezien (1)' button; creating order 2 bumps title to (2) and badge increments while startRing is guarded (code review of ringTimerRef guard confirms single setInterval); 'Markeer als gezien' clears badge, resets title, stopRing cuts master gain and clears interval, and NO re-trigger occurs over 13s of further polling; accepting the last new order prunes it from unseenIds and clears the badge/title; disabling alerts flips the toggle label back to 'Meldingen aanzetten' (ring loop stops; badge remains independent as spec'd); SPA navigation away from Bestellingen restores document.title to 'Upxero Ordering' (verified via sidebar click, not hard reload); hard reload re-seeds and does NOT falsely alert for pre-existing new orders; staff login can access the Orders screen and sees the restaurant's orders (tenant isolation intact). No pageerror or AudioContext/Notification errors observed. Audio output itself is not asserted in headless (per instructions).
critical_code_review_comments: startRing() is correctly guarded by `if (ringTimerRef.current) return;` — a second new order cannot stack a second setInterval loop.
stopRing() both clears the interval AND sets masterGain to 0, so any already-scheduled oscillator tails are muted immediately on markSeen / accept / reject / disable / unmount.

detectNew() prunes unseenIds against the fresh id set from the latest /orders response, so accept/reject naturally removes those ids and the ring-loop effect [alertsOn, unseen] stops the loop when unseen hits 0.
Unmount cleanup correctly stopRings, closes AudioContext, nulls refs and resets document.title to 'Upxero Ordering' — verified via SPA navigation.
First-load seeding uses seededRef.current — if the first /orders call fails, orders is set to [] and detectNew is not called, so seeding happens on first successful response (safe behavior).

Minor: notifyBrowser is still called inside detectNew without an explicit guard beyond `alertsOn` — fine, but if the browser denies permission the Notification constructor is wrapped in try/catch so no errors leak.
No new deps, no WebSocket/SSE/push, no backend changes. Polling remains 10s. Ring interval 3000ms matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 public orders via POST /api/public/restaurant/bistro-demo/orders (orderNumbers ~1097-1100) during the test; one was accepted, others left as 'new'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard orders route is /dashboard/bestellingen (NL). Public menu API shape is {restaurant, categories, items} where items are top-level (NOT nested under categories). To create orders from Python, use a browser User-Agent header or page.evaluate fetch. For SPA navigation checks (document.title restoration), click sidebar links instead of page.goto (which triggers hard reload and resets to index.html default title 'Emergent | Fullstack App'). Alerts feature (louder repeating ring, dedup via ringTimerRef, prune-on-accept/reject) verified end-to-end at 2026-01.
